mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases > 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the real GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it indicates a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is negative and UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary period with tightening monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% within a month signals a weakening demand for housing, leading to reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% within a month.
